html:
SMTO-EML-0020 — SMTO can't find the email sender you picked

GUID: fbe7c2d2-862c-541f-9491-1864b501623b
Slug: email-sender-profile-missing
Domain: EML · Subsystem: email-smtp

What happened

  • SMTO looked for the saved email sender (the account it sends mail from), but nothing is saved under that name. No email was sent.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open More options › Parameter Store and search for the sender name you used (the part after @, such as work_email). The name must match a saved entry exactly, so a typo or a renamed entry makes SMTO miss it.
  2. If it isn't listed, pick an Email / SMTP template in the new parameter template list, fill in your mail server and account details, and select Save. SMTO only sends from senders saved in Parameter Store, so the sender has to exist first.
  3. Back in your conversation, ask SMTO again and name the sender exactly as saved, for example @work_email. Using the exact saved name lets SMTO find the right sender.

What success looks like

  • SMTO finds the sender and shows the email preview for you to approve, or returns a connection test result.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Before asking SMTO to send again, check your Sent folder or ask a recipient whether an earlier attempt already arrived.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Email profile resolution failed in preparation: Parameter Store has no record for the selected canonical profile key (EmailError email_profile_not_found, field profile_key).

What this means

  • The selected saved sender profile could not be found. The producer identifies the failed field or preparation stage without exposing private values.

Why this can happen

  • The exact selected profile lookup returns no record.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the reported field, failure phase and retained receipt before choosing a correction.

How to fix it

  • Compare the profile_key passed to the email tool with the Parameter Store keys (store.get_exact on the canonical key, without the leading @). Create an email_smtp or gmail_app_password_account record under that key, or correct the reference; check earlier send receipts before repeating any previous uncertain send.
  • Select an existing Email / SMTP profile or create the intended sender profile in Parameter Store.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the reported condition first. Retry only when existing execution and effect evidence permits it; reconcile an uncertain prior send.

How to verify the fix

  • The exact selected profile can be read and validates.

What not to do

  • Do not infer an authentication rejection from local validation. Preserve the recorded execution and delivery evidence before any retry.
